_doc: The words of the part cards (scripts/ui/describe.gd builds them; hud_card.gd, hud_palette.gd, weapon_bar.gd and crafting_panel.gd show them). families: what a family does, 8 words at most ({break_delay} is filled from the game's own data). keywords: one per mechanic: {label, color, hover}. The label is upper case, and {n}-style holes are filled from the part (describe.gd); the hover line is 12 words at most. kinds of weapon and types of damage are keywords too (laser, bolt, flak, missile, beam; energy, kinetic, explosive, ion), and so is every key of a weapon's `effects` (scripts/combat/effects.gd). The colours read on the dark panels and differ from each other and from the line colours (tests/test_describe.gd measures it). items, tiles: the line of a cargo item, a wall or floor. idle: tags the data carries that no code reads yet (describe.gd leaves them out, so the card never promises what the game does not do). stats: a row for each key of a part's `stats`: [label, template] with {v} for the number, or [label, template, 'skip' | 'if_not_1']. tests/test_describe.gd checks that nothing in use is missing here.

families.helm: Flies the ship. Press E here to steer.
families.shield: Absorbs hits in layers before the hull.
families.medbay_arm: Arm that heals one crew in reach.
families.radiator: Cools every part in its room.
families.intake: Pulls in debris that touches it.
families.tractor: Hold Q to haul debris to an intake.
families.ram: Reinforced bow: hits hard, latches on.
families.ammo_rack: Stores ammo for guns in its room.
families.belt_drive: Moves ammo along belts to guns.

bolt.label: BOLT
bolt.hover: A shot that flies to the target. Shields stop it.

flak.label: FLAK
flak.hover: A cone of pellets. Short range.

beam.label: BEAM
beam.hover: Held on the target for seconds. Hits what it sweeps.

energy.label: ENERGY
energy.hover: Hot light. Ablative and mirrored plating resist it.

kinetic.label: KINETIC
kinetic.hover: Solid shot. Armour plating resists it best.

explosive.label: EXPLOSIVE
explosive.hover: Blast. Scrap plate takes extra, heavy armour resists.

ion.label: ION
ion.hover: Knocks shields out and stuns crew.

auto.label: AUTO
auto.hover: Aims and fires by itself. T toggles.

chain.label: CHAIN {steps}
chain.hover: Fires faster each volley, up to {steps} steps.

charge.label: CHARGE {max}
charge.hover: Stores up to {max} volleys idle, then fires them.

pierce.label: PIERCE {n}
pierce.hover: Goes on through up to {n} more cells.

splash.label: SPLASH {n}
splash.hover: Also hits cells up to {n} away.

pass_shields.label: PASSES SHIELDS
pass_shields.hover: Ignores shields and hits the hull.

intercept.label: INTERCEPT
intercept.hover: Shoots down enemy missiles within {range} px first.

ammo.label: AMMO
ammo.hover: Spends one {ammo} from the cargo per shot.

ammo_mult.label: HUNGRY
ammo_mult.hover: Spends x{ammo_mult} the ammo per shot.

fire.label: FIRE {p}%
fire.hover: Each shot may light a fire where it hits.

jam.label: JAMS {p}%
jam.hover: Volleys can jam it until crew clear it.

heat.label: HEAT {n}
heat.hover: Each shot adds {n} heat. Needs a radiator.

breach.label: BREACH {p}%
breach.hover: A hit may blow a wall cell out.

manned.label: MANNED+
manned.hover: Works better with crew in its room.

hot.label: HOT
hot.hover: Overheats on its own. Needs a radiator.

acid.label: ACID
acid.hover: Eats the cell it hits for {seconds} s, and spreads.

spores.label: SPORES
spores.hover: The room it hits loses air for {seconds} s.

sonic.label: SONIC
sonic.hover: Stuns crew in the room it hits for {stun_s} s.

magnetic.label: MAGNETIC
magnetic.hover: Pulls the enemy ship toward you.

frost.label: FROST
frost.hover: The system it hits charges {slow%}% slower for {seconds} s.

corrode.label: CORRODE
corrode.hover: Hit wall or door takes {inv}x damage for {seconds} s.

split_on_shield.label: SPLITS
split_on_shield.hover: A shot a shield stops breaks into {count} fragments.

self_room.label: BACK-BLAST
self_room.hover: Each shot hurts its own room.

needs_operator.label: NEEDS {who}
needs_operator.hover: Works at x{else_mult} {stat} without one at the gun.

needs_crew_in_room.label: NEEDS {count} CREW
needs_crew_in_room.hover: Works at x{else_mult} {stat} with fewer in its room.

faulty.label: FAULTY
faulty.hover: Malfunctions about {n} a minute. Crew clear it.

ion_weak.label: ION-WEAK
ion_weak.hover: Ion hits do x{n} damage to it.

ablative.label: ABLATIVE
ablative.hover: Each energy hit takes 1 from its max hp.

lattice_power.label: LATTICE
lattice_power.hover: Turns some absorbed energy into ship power.

ram.label: RAM ×{deal}
ram.hover: Ram damage dealt x{deal}, taken x{take}.

mod.label: MOD
mod.hover: A device worn in a kit slot. It changes a boarding.

items.ammo: Ammo for guns that use it.
items.gear: Crew gear. Not placed on the ship.
items.special: Held until something asks for it.
items.material: Raw material for recipes and trade.
items.mod: A small device worn in a kit slot. It changes how a boarding goes.

tiles.floor: Crew walk on it. Systems stand on it.
tiles.wall: Hull wall. Stops shots and air.
tiles.door: Crew pass through. E opens it.
tiles.cable: Carries power from reactors to parts.
tiles.belt: Carries ammo from racks to guns.
